title: etcd cluster unhealthy state on SLES 12
body:
# Bug reporting

I am setting up a three-nodes etcd cluster on SuSE Linux Enterprise Server 12 by following the instructions at https://github.com/coreos/etcd/blob/master/Documentation/op-guide/clustering.md. The cluster is up and running, I could use etcdctl set /foo bar to add entries. But the etcdctl cluster-health shows unhealthy.

**Cluster Nodes**

10.4.35.10 c910f04x35k10 SLES 12
10.4.35.11 c910f04x35k11 SLES 12
10.4.35.12 c910f04x35k12 SLES 12

The etcd service is managed by systemd

**etcd version:**

```
c910f04x35k10:~ # etcd --version
etcd Version: 3.1.0-rc.1+git
Git SHA: b713113
Go Version: go1.7.4
Go OS/Arch: linux/amd64
c910f04x35k10:~ # 
```


**on 10.4.35.10:**
```
c910f04x35k10:~ # ps -ef | grep -i etcd
root      2554     1  1 02:39 ?        00:00:04 /opt/bin/etcd --name infra0 --data-dir /var/lib/etcd/default.etcd --listen-peer-urls http://10.4.35.10:2380 --listen-client-urls http://10.4.35.10:2379,http://127.0.0.1:2379 --initial-cluster infra0=http://10.4.35.10:2380,infra1=http://10.4.35.11:2380,infra2=http://10.4.35.12:2380 --advertise-client-urls http://10.4.35.10:2379 --initial-advertise-peer-urls http://10.4.35.10:2380 --initial-cluster-token kube-etcd --initial-cluster-state new
c910f04x35k10:~ # 
```
**on 10.4.35.11:**

```
c910f04x35k11:~ # ps -ef | grep -i etcd
root      1767     1  1 02:40 ?        00:00:04 /opt/bin/etcd --name infra1 --data-dir /var/lib/etcd/default.etcd --listen-peer-urls http://10.4.35.11:2380 --listen-client-urls http://10.4.35.11:2379,http://127.0.0.1:2379 --initial-cluster infra0=http://10.4.35.10:2380,infra1=http://10.4.35.11:2380,infra2=http://10.4.35.12:2380 --advertise-client-urls http://10.4.35.11:2379 --initial-advertise-peer-urls http://10.4.35.11:2380 --initial-cluster-token kube-etcd --initial-cluster-state new
c910f04x35k11:~ # 
```
**on 10.4.35.12:**

```
c910f04x35k12:~ # ps -ef | grep -i etcd
root      1612     1  1 02:40 ?        00:00:04 /opt/bin/etcd --name infra2 --data-dir /var/lib/etcd/default.etcd --listen-peer-urls http://10.4.35.12:2380 --listen-client-urls http://10.4.35.12:2379,http://127.0.0.1:2379 --initial-cluster infra0=http://10.4.35.10:2380,infra1=http://10.4.35.11:2380,infra2=http://10.4.35.12:2380 --advertise-client-urls http://10.4.35.12:2379 --initial-advertise-peer-urls http://10.4.35.12:2380 --initial-cluster-token kube-etcd --initial-cluster-state new
c910f04x35k12:~ # 
```

**When the cluster is up and running:**

**etcdctl member list shows the members correctly:**

```
c910f04x35k11:~ # etcdctl member list
1cd3725776a8ad50: name=infra0 peerURLs=http://10.4.35.10:2380 clientURLs=http://10.4.35.10:2379 isLeader=false
cb83eda8a3eae07c: name=infra1 peerURLs=http://10.4.35.11:2380 clientURLs=http://10.4.35.11:2379 isLeader=true
ea6f85a7a2683731: name=infra2 peerURLs=http://10.4.35.12:2380 clientURLs=http://10.4.35.12:2379 isLeader=false
c910f04x35k11:~ # 
```
**etcdctl set /foo bar works:**

```
c910f04x35k11:~ # etcdctl set /foo bar
bar
c910f04x35k11:~ # 

c910f04x35k12:~ # etcdctl get /foo
bar
c910f04x35k12:~ # 
```

**But the ectdctl cluster-health shows unhealthy:**

```
c910f04x35k11:~ # etcdctl cluster-health
member 1cd3725776a8ad50 is unhealthy: got unhealthy result from http://10.4.35.10:2379
member cb83eda8a3eae07c is unhealthy: got unhealthy result from http://10.4.35.11:2379
member ea6f85a7a2683731 is unhealthy: got unhealthy result from http://10.4.35.12:2379
cluster is unhealthy
c910f04x35k11:~ # 
```
